Have used this airport twice in the last year and found it very smooth From plane arriving at terminal only ten minutes to clear border control collect bags and exit airport Bus to Gothenburg outside terminal to meet each flight and in to city in about minutes quicker than from the main Gothenburg airport Adequate facilities in airport and an outside area airside for smokers to sit in the sun with a drink

Sukhothai Airport owned by Bangkok Boutique Airlines is a great little secret gem not to be missed Due to its size you feel like a celebrity A flower festooned approach greeted by security officers in their shorts and old colonial hats checking in outdoors the open feel the gardens water dripping from the roof to keep customers cool The check in staff all line up and wai you to send you off and the ground staff at the aircraft do the same Priority boarding for monks of course Exotic and fabulous with the usual Bangkok Airlines free drinks and snacks

HKGBKK I booked with them because it was the only airline available Check in took hr in HKG and plane was a year old B Entertainment was pretty much nothing and seats were the most uncomfortable Ive ever experienced Plane and bathroom were unclean I booked a seat in the upper deck and it was quiet Food was horrible Only good thing was the value because I you pretty much get everything for that cheap price

It was years ago I used this airport and wow so much has changed The check in on nd level had moved to a much more spacious rd level It made the experience totally different in a positive way No longer does it feel cramped Staff are friendly and signage are very clear The only thing that still need improving is the variety of shops available air side and food options It is still pretty basic at this stage With more and more airlines flying to OKA they can be more ambitious and open up more shops and restaurants to cater for us
LuganoAgno is a little airport maybe the smallest in Switzerland but I think its the most efficient Its commercial says Youll be in the air in minutes and its the truth I think its a great airport

Morning flight on PR from Daraga to Manila I have international connection in a separate booking booking but check in agent made it sure my luggage was checked through to my final destination which was so much appreciated as it saved me time and effort at Manila Airport Flight was smooth and on time Ticket price was reasonable
This is a smashing little airport friendly well laid out and very well run Because of its location very attractive to fly in and out of too always a big shock returning to Gatwick Good ice cream too

Manila to Legazpi DRP on Christmas Day Flight was full but went smooth Checkin was a breeze Mabuhay Lounge food was OK though I was hoping for some extra flare on this special day Wasnt a problem though Flight took off slightly ahead of schedule Bags first to arrive at DRP due to Elite status Ticket price was reasonable for this season
Great airport not many flights so no hassle From check in to take off minutes Car parking also free

Frequented CMB many times in the last decade and on the whole its ok It runs pretty smoothly and in fact has improved over the years the immigration particularly seems quicker I do however hate the exorbitant dollar priced fooddrink and duty free etc The contrast between what this cost just outside the door or the airport and the terminal prices must be one of the biggest contrasts in the world That said its a pretty painless experience to pass through

I tried to arrange a group trip with SyrianAir from London to Aleppo via Damascus and back Initially all was fine until they cancelled the first leg of the journey to Damascus a week prior to us leaving The next flight was days later but there was no immediate plane to Aleppo once we had arrived at Damascus which meant we would have to take a bus up instead a journey we werent too keen on While friendly the staff are fairly useless and I sat for MANY hours trying to sort things out We changed the flights to stay the same number of days but decided to go to Aleppo at the tail end of the trip under our own steam and the fly Allepo to London again via Damascus on the same ticket Unfortunately the staff didnt really get the group concept and kept issuing tickets for the wrong dates for different members of the group It took too many visits to their offices in Baker Street to finally get everyone on the same flights at the same time The flight to Syria was fine late and we managed to get up to Aleppo ourselves but the day before we were to fly out again we went into the Syrian air offices to confirm everything was ok IT WAS NOT They had cancelled the flight to Damascus without informing any of us and we had to arrange a midnight bus from Aleppo to Damascus Airport to make the correct flight back to London Luckily this one hadnt been cancelled But it was late My advice Dont Fly SyrianAir and if you do check on your flights constantly

Bydgoszcz airport is very small but there are many people traveling through it daily There are no shops only one cafe and newsagents both in the duty free area Security checks are usually fast and check ins go smoothly This city would benefit from a much bigger airport and hopefully it will soon have one

I expected the worst but to my surprise its one of the smoothest flight I have ever hard Everything was good other than the seats that needs a mattress to make them comfortable for sleeping The staff were good I will fly it anytime I prioritise feeling safe

This airport is so backward its unreal Today you get charged nearly three euros to get hot water for your own teabag You get charged ten euros development fee as you leave Same as Galway airport ten years ago six euros to get out again development fee now its shut Last time I flew from Knock the fee was the same Never went back because of the fee Now the place has hardly changed where did that money go Great idea to put an airport on top of a hill dont have to come down so far but hardly a great advert for Irish aviation or Mayo

Nice small low cost but very aged airport needs full reconstruction asap Everything looks like the s but not nice way The floor was dirty so they need to improve cleaning as well Restaurant was closed so there was nowhere to even get a coffee Staff were kind and helpful Will fly there again as FR and W operate nice cheap flights otherwise no chance will be back

I was rather disappointed by the lack of knowledge from the staff and security control I suffered a Sudden Cardiac Arrest in April and due to no cause for this incident happening I was fitted with an Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator ICD later that month This is a small metal device wired up to my heart that acts as a failsafe if the situation arises that I was to have another Cardiac Arrest As this is inside my body it is near impossible to take it out Due to the nature of this device I have been advised not to go through metal detectors as it could trigger my device into action and as such I contact the airport before flying to do so explaining I will be carrying my Patient Identification Card on the flight which gives the information in English French and German This normally is suffice information and when I inform a member of staff at an airport they allow me to come round the side of the metal detector to be searched by a member of staff However when doing so at Katowice I was rather rudely told to put my Identification Card in the tray with my bag while I was trying to explain to another staff member what it was and why I couldnt go through I was told to go through anyway and it would be fine As expected my device did set off the metal detector and I stepped aside to be searched On being searched the staff member felt where my ICD was and asked me to take it off despite it being inside my body I explained how it was inside my body and couldnt be taken out and while he seemed to understand this my body search seemed a lot more rough than normal I felt this was a very inappropriate comment for a staff member to make and I was very disappointed at the way I was treated by the staff almost with suspicion While I am fine with flying now the first few times I did so I was very nervous and grateful for the support given by staff members who I explained my situation to My worry is if someone else travelling for the first time was treated like this they may have a panic attack at the airport and be reluctant to travel by plane in the future

Dar es salaam to Mbeya I bought my ticket in October on the Fastjet website I turned up to fly in February from Dar to Mbrya to be told by airport staff that the airline had ceased flying Right up until the day if departure its website still showed the flight as on time They never even bothered sending me an email telling me they werent flying any more Then I sent seven emails and made five phone calls to their office asking for a refund phone was never answered emails never replied to I went to their office this morning and demanded a refund they now say they will give me my money back in working days time I will wait to see if it happens Be warned do not fly with this airline

This case seems warranted as a warning to anyone with a disability and related service dog After calling Porter to report traveling with a service animal a month in advance submitting appropriate documentation and being approved to travel with said dog I arrived at the Toronto airport to check in and was told no service dog was on record I provided my printed documentation which was scoured for the next minutes Finally the check in assistant approved my paperwork and added a service dog to my reservation They checked my bags printed my boarding passes and we proceeded to the gate to wait for boarding to begin When the gate attendant scanned my ticket I was moved to the side so Porter could finish boarding Porter employees then proceeded to close the gate and inform me I was barred from boarding the flight because my service dog was not documented Considering we fly together on flights a year I thought there must be some mistake Much to my dismay Porter both gate attendant and disability help line told me they couldnt point me in the direction of assistance refund me or help me in any way shape or form beyond their toll free customer service number hr estimated hold time They said they didnt have my documentation in their call center so I was not allowed to fly I was instructed to go back out of TSA security pick up my checked bags on a carrousel and wait hours after resubmitting my service dogs paperwork to try and rebook Sweat tears and hours later AirCanada got me a flight on the spot accepted the same paperwork and did not discriminate against me for having a disability which requires me to travel with an animal trained to attend to my medical needs

It seems several flights have arrived at once and immigration is not geared up to deal with so many passengers even though Malaga is now the th largest airport in Spain So far weve waited mins and its still a long way to go No information provided over the speakers and no staff to explain why the delay

First impressions of the airport when entering are pretty good there was staff at the entrance that were eager to help However the check in counter is then a different story Security behind the luggage x day scanner at check in was rude and disrespectful at best Both the person in front of me and I were unaware that we packed a portable charger in our check in that was our fault fine But the security staff then shouted at us to open our luggage he then proceeded to throw things in our luggage all over a table without a single touch of care He then swore at us in front of everyone and pronounced that the other person and I were idiots How this airport can put up a four star plaque with confidence is beyond my belief I have never encountered such a toxic person in the air travel industry For reference this was on in the evening at check in counter

Flight delay on December from HKG to BKK for hours It was supposed to be an early morning flight ended up arriving BKK at pm My family needs to transfer to Pattaya which ended up losing one day vacation No customer service staff at Hong Kong airport to explain the situation and all passengers were stuck at the airport

Selected vegetarian meals for these flights and they were provided as requested quite tasty too Very pleased with the extra legroom seats despite the costs but confusion appeared to reign with the seat numbers fortunately the cabin staff were okay and we laughed it off However despite your spouse who also requested a veg meal suggests you swap seats on the long haul it certainly makes a flight attendant frown were both the same surname btw Now given what happened with the Singapore Airlines incident in bad turbulence last year does it really warrant a ban on hot drinks due to an odd bump or small bounce The second flight was great but leg room was a bit tight However thank you to the attendant who asked the woman in front to realign her seat because I couldnt get my tray table down

Travelled with Air New Zealand on Boeing Auckland to Honolulu in business class The ground handling was some of the best I have experienced Regrettably the experience quickly became more than a little disappointing The layout in herringbone pattern resulted in providing no privacy and very limited space Given that the herringbone style was already discredited by the time ANZ introduced this pattern it is hard to understand why they went with that option The appalling layout was only exceeded by the extremely poor onboard service with poor menu choice and failure to provide the supper and breakfast requested It gave the impression that the attendants didnt know what they were doing or were not interested As a long term user of ANZ and having found their serviceproduct very competitive this latest experience has left me looking to other airlines for long haul flights what a shame

The airport advertises Verified Traveller program and has signage but this option didnt exist I was shunted into regular lineup When I asked the security guard about it he shrugged told me to empty out everything and looked away until I started doing it As I was packed for the express line and they are very old school wanting belts etc off laptops in their own tray I ended up using trays Grateful I didnt have kids with me

Do not fly with this company I booked a flight from Lago Agrio to Quito for the morning of March From Quito I had connecting flights to Panama and then to Los Angeles leaving at pm On March rd while I was on a bus into Lago Agrio Tame alerted me that my flight had been rescheduled for pm which meant I could not catch my connecting flights I spent half of my stay trying to get hold of someone at the company to see about rescheduling or arranging a refund but never succeeded No one ever picked up the phone or returned my messages I also talked to Priceline and they could not reach the company either Instead I reluctantly cut my visit short and took an overnight bus back to Quito to catch my remaining flights At the airport I spoke to the Tame desk who told me they could not work with me and gave me an email address The email address doesnt work Priceline filed a refund request on my behalf which Tame has denied Tame is not an airline company it is a racket Avoid them at all costs

Getting worse and worse We arrived on a from JFK They didnt have a gate for us the put us on a parking space and said that we were going to deplane by bus The stairs took minutes to arrive and almost an hour to finally get us to emigration This airport is not even the shadow of what used to be

God bless the amazing lady from Flint Michigan I cant remember her name I threw my back out the day before my flight I was hunched over and could barely walk She got a wheel chair for me and took me though security and all the way to my gate Waited for my plane and rolled me down the jet bridge I dont know what I wouldve done without her kindness I hope she knows how much shes appreciated

Dinard Airport arrival experience was excellent I was second off the plane so got out within minutes Departure was a nightmare hrs queuing to get through passport control and security Theres only one Douane and security lane which isnt enough for full Ryanair flights Our flight had to be delayed by mins so everyone could get on Once in the departure lounge there is limited seating and a vending machine thats all and just toilets for everyone The terrace bar before security is very nice though

Hangzhou to Macau I have had the misfortune of flying Air Macau numerous times over the past years On virtually every occasion the flight has been late often by at least hours The airline has the annoying habit of boarding passengers first and only then informing them of the delay creating a long and frustrating wait on the tarmac The Macau Beijing route seems particularly liable to delay but recently I have travelled on Air Macau to Hangzhou and Nanjing and both flights were hours late with little or no explanation Air Macau gives the impression that it simply does not care After many years of international travel Air Macau is quite simply the most unreliable airline I have ever had the misfortune to fly on

This was the First time i choose WestJet and it will be the last time The delay was about hours without any reasons First they said it has a delay for two hours because they want to repair the airplane Then they added one hour after one hour After five hours delay they said we cant repair this airplane and we will give you another one After hours the new airplane arrive from Winnipeg to Toronto When the passenger came out of the plane they said we have to find captain and crew for this airplane plane Finally after hours we departed I have never had a like this delay

Skymark is fine when all goes well On the outbound trip from Tokyo to Shin Chitose my partner and I had no problems Checking was done by machine and boarding was prompt Inflight seats are okay and legroom is okay for an LCC The return trip never happened We checked in and went to get lunch at the airport before the flight As we made our way to security we saw the flight was canceled As all other SkyMark flights to Tokyo were full we were told we had find our own way back after which point we could apply for reimbursement of our new tickets cost All other airlines serving HND were full today so we ended up on Vanilla Air to NRT and getting home nearly nine hours later than planned Skymark followed their rules so we cannot fault their front line staff for the lack of service The bottom line with Skymark is that unless you are prepared to fend for yourself if something goes wrong its better to pay a bit more for an airline like JAL or ANA that is focused on customer service

Tehran to Shiraz with Iran Aseman Airlines The F is old The windows are scratched and poor The seats are not comfortable and ugly Nice takeoff and landing but even at the front of the plane the engines are noisy The plane was old and not so clean Really not a good time on the flight Cabin staff are nice and catering is not bad Overall its not good

Visited through this Airport nd time for Umrah in Jeddah Airport North Terminal The women Immigration officers were pathetic and unprofessional Always busy with their own business and not doing the immigration work One of the women Immigration officer asked my partner if she can speak Arabic my wife replied No in response to my wifes reply the officer questions back why not It is none of her business if my wife could speak Arabic or not The women officers react as if they are doing a top level job or something extra ordinary they are not polite at all

Never again This is a classic sentence said by customers and I really hope we will never need to buy tickets with Azul again We tried to book a flight from Manaus to Rio de Janeiro but the process was extremely complicated because we are not Brazilian and dont have a CPF It took forever and we had to try multiple times Eventually we managed to book the tickets and received a confirmation email so we assumed everything was fine However a few days later we realized they had sent another email saying the payment was pendingfor reasons unknown No problem we thought Lets try again Thats when the real trouble began We wanted to pay again using a card but it wasnt possible They offered PIX as a payment option but as foreigners we dont have access to PIX What were we supposed to do We tried to contact customer service We called different numbers sent an email and even messaged them on Facebook and Instagram No responseuntil finally after minutes on hold someone picked up The Azul representative told us the only way to fix the payment issue was to go to the Manaus airport in person up to four hours before the flight This was not a solution for us We were on an organized tour in the Amazon and couldnt just leaveand its so why couldnt they send us a payment link to finalize the process Still the answer was no Finally a kind Brazilian offered to help us pay via PIX We sent her the payment link but it expired in just seven minutes We sent another link but after that we werent given another chance to try The result We had to cancel a night and a day of our tour lose money and deal with immense frustration Azuls customer service is nonexistent They dont help and they seem to actively make things difficult for foreigners by requiring CPF for booking and PIX for payment To make matters worse their tickets arent even cheap
The price of the fare was very reasonable and affordable but there was no food on board served for free unless you ordered and paid for it also there was no entertainment screen to watch movies

Didnt actually fly Georgian Airways I attempted for a day and a half to book a flight on their website Incredibly cumbersome and user unfriendly site I got to the end and tried to pay the site site churned for a long time then switched back to the pay screen requiring me to reenter everything This happened I believe more than a dozen times A couple of entries just resulted in a failed screen If I waited too long I was required to additionally reenter all my demographics I sent an email to the airline requesting assistance I received no response The next day I tried again Finally switched from my Visa to an American Express card This resulted in being emailed an AMEX SafeKey code to verify I wanted to use this vendor Being emailed the code meant that my card info had been entered correctly I gain emailed the airline for assistance hours alter Ive not received any response

I got extremely frustrated by how none of the toilets in the entire airport were suitable for a toddler My daughter is too old to wear diapers but also too small to use a big and scary adultsized toilet seat None of the toilets were equipped with a childsized toilet seat or even a plastic potty so she ended up peeing herself in frustration both on arrival and our departure a few days later The airport is small but otherwise meets all expectations you might have of a modern airport so I found this particular lack of preparedness extremely strange

Boarding was by bus departure on time Plane was in a good condition There was a limited IFE through your mobile adequate for such a hour flight Inflight service was a bottle of water There was buy MENU available

Seoul to Kuala Lumpur When we arrived at the airport min before departure time the counter was empty Nobody up there and the automatic checkin was disabled After walking all over to find their offices we were greeted by an employee who told us they closed the counter min prior to flight as a company policy There was no effort on her part to open the door or offering any alternatives I dislike that attitude in any kind of service

Gold Coast to Melbourne Absolutely shocking will never fly with this unprofessional airline again I tried checking into my flight online a few hours before the flight left their app would not let me I also tried using webjet which just rejected my check in I had no luggage with me so I had planned to get everything I needed to get done in Gold Coast before my flight and walk on smoothly minutes before it departed however because of their online check in not working and being put on hold for an hour just to ask someone to assist over the phone I missed my flight Nobody cared to help me out or even compensate me in the slightest way for their website and app faults The man at the counter just informed me that if you dont have an allocated seat on the flight your check in online wont work Great thanks for the heads up I would love to see where that is outlined for their passengers to follow The next flight was a few hours later for I am only a student and would rather pay to get onto a JetstarQantas flight so that I never have to deal with them again

Its an airport that is showing its age and needs urgent remodelling Immigration security checks and customs were relatively fast but there are certain peak times when many international flights arrive and this may cause things to slow down I couldnt believe my ears when asked where the elevator was and they told me that it was out of order When travelling with heavy bags this isnt what you want to hear Wifi provided by Airplan was good but tends to get slow during hectic hours Medellin has seen a recent increase in the number of passengers international flights and could be an alternative to the nice Bogota International Airport but a lot of effort and work has to be done before this materialises

Purchased a book of flight vouchers for the Phoenix to Show Low route in December Boutique dropped this route in July and are dragging their feet on refunding my unused vouchers Have spoken with customer service twice in July and September and been told they would be refunded but as of October they have not

We were not aware that our cabin suitcase was cm too wide Our last trip was last January when the suitcases were still with us We have now paid euros twice for Cabin Baggage and Priority Boarding euros euro surcharge on suitcases on the outward journey euros for the two suitcases as checked luggage on the return journey That is euros for two kilo suitcases that were centimeters too wide In addition we were unable to use priority boarding on the outward journey because we had to pay the surcharge at a very busy counter All in all a big damper on our holiday fun We believe that we have been disproportionately affected by Transavias new baggage rules

I took my annual vacation to Cebu Philippines in November The attendants are not very professional nor friendly The return flight was even worse The flight from Seoul ICN was the biggest issue The flight boarded and took off but had to return to the airport for a technical issue The flight attendant said the plane was out of balance This was after hours into the flight Then we were put on the Skybridge while the problems more than just the weight distribution were fixed One point to consider was I had a hour layover in Seoul We finally took off again after a long wait Upon arriving in San Francisco SFO the connecting flight had taken off an hour earlier I was supposed to have a hour layover in SFO I had to wait another hours for another flight no meal voucher no hotel room no compensation After finally arriving in Raleigh RDU my luggage was not present So I had to file a claim for lost luggage No compensation or any concern about it The Luggage claims desk did not even know there was a flight arriving that morning I had to make numerous phone calls one representative actually laughed about it I have not received any compensation from United for their lack of professionalism and availability to conduct a flight operation within a reasonable schedule

FRADYUFRA I was a little dubious about this airline but both flights were on time and in a new aircraft FRADYU was six hours had a basic dinner and soft drink service no alcohol and sandwich before arrival Crew passed out thick blankets but no pillows No IFE either DYUFRA left at am Tajik time no food service on an overnight flight I would fly again because of convenience its hard to get to Dushanbe

What an experience Genghis Khan ULN proved to be I arrived with my small group at for an MIAT flight Several full flights and staffed checkin desks No queuing system exists pushing and shoving is standard Checkin staff vanish leaving empty desks No management and nobody can answer questions We started queuing at and we were finally checked in at Other than the checkin hall and a blur of corridors as I ran to the aircraft I saw nothing of the airport Recommendations Time the patience of a saint and stand your ground Oh and a small child seems to be a golden ticket the the front of the queue

Lugano to Biarritz via Geneva with Eithad Regional operated by Darwin Airline Cabin Crew very nice check in and security check in Lugano and Biarritz very fast and without problems But the route never again it is more comfortable by TGV even if a hour trip In Geneva for minutes and obliged to leave the aircraft wait for hand baggage brought with the bus at GVA airport run through the airport found an immense queue to pass again the security check I was ashamed to run to the front of the queue and arrived to go back on the bus to return to the same aircraft same crew Tried during the previous to find out how to avoid the same crazy run on the flight back to Lugano without answers Last Monday arrived hours before departure in Biarritz with no possibility to have the boarding pass from GVA to Lugano but confirmation by check in staff that we could stay on the aircraft and receive the boarding pass from security crew However in GVA obliged to leave the aircraft to run the same crazy way but with the new difficulty to pass the security check without boarding pass whilst our names were called as last call to the gate Arrived to the gate with a whole bus waiting the employee gave us the boarding cards and asked us but why did you not remain on the aircraft After days we are always waiting an answer from Eithad Regional

MNL Bacolod MNL Outbound trip OK No real issues apart from PAL Express web site stating all PAL Express flights leave from NAIA terminal when in fact this one leaves from Terminal Plane OK and cabin service pretty much what you would expect from a low cost airline Return journey absolutely dreadful Arrived Bacolod in plenty of time and checked in No mention at check in of any delays Passed through to airside where indicators showed the flight now scheduled at No explanation offered and no staff visible to ask Around finally an announcement that the aircraft would arrive at and depart at No apology or explanation offered Eventually boarded after and took off around Attempted to ask gate staff why the delay and received the meaningless response false alarm at Manila After hours in an airport with no food outlets cabin service amounted to a dry biscuit and some water On arrival at Manila all the usual arrival announcements were made and only as an afterthought was an apology made for the late arrival but again no explanation given We then parked at a remote stand Not an issue except that no steps could be found for about minutes De planing then seemed to take an age The reason for this became apparent as we reached the top of the stairs A flight with about people on board was being serviced by a single bus with capacity for around at a time Result nearly an hour from landing to reach the terminal All in all as a national carrier PAL bring shame on their nation

The Boeing J class recliner seat is old not comfortable no IFE Breakfast service is a misery omelet served with chunks of hard boiled beef My Boeing J class seat not cleaned previous passenger blankets tossed in the legs compartment oily window glass dust and hair all over the place Pictures attached for you to judge Sad to pay that much for such a miserable service

Airport team charged extra for the seats saying i have not booked the seats My questions is when i book a flight ticket technically am i not also booking a seat then why was i asked to pay extra for the seat When i asked for a free seat it was denied and in hurry were made to pay for the seat This is something against our will No airlines charges extra unless it is preferred seat

Trapani is still a partly military airport with fencing all around the civilian area and perhaps this is why it seems so crowded and perhaps because Ryanair have hugely increased their flights recently The result is that the landside arrivals was crowded but not too bad but the car park was full and the car hire area overflowing with double treble and quadruple parked cars Finding the right person and right car and attempting to get out of the airport was not easy and all this despite the airport saying that the number of parking and car hire spaces have been increased recently On the way back the departure lounge with nice views which would be pretty much filled up with three planes full was further strained by the fact that there were about or more extra aircraft at the airport due to Palermo being temporarily closed a Windjet aircraft had landed metres short of the runway Overall Trapani is fine but it seems to be reaching saturation despite recent extensions both inside and out Whilst it was a minor irritation for us I imagine a few extra passengers could cause problems of the sort to make you tear your hair out Just hope that you dont arrive immediately after a couple of other aircraft or you could be in for a long wait for your baggage car hire etc and just getting out of the car park

New York to Catania via Milan We flew business class on the way over on this trip Service was okay Food was not great Upon arrival despite having priority tags on our bags my bag never showed up in Sicily There was no way to contact anyone at Air Italy and they only have person who manages lost and found bags No compensation or return upgrade was offered I had to spend every day trying to track my bag and spend money to replace things A complete waste of precious vacation time We arrived on Saturday afternoon and I didnt get my bag until Thursday afternoon we left Italy a few days later When I inspected my bag I realized they cut through sections of the bag even though there was a TSA lock and I gave them the code They also went through my belongings for no reason my original tag with name and information was still attached Everything was just shoved back in haphazardly It was also impossible to get a hold of anyone on the phone used the US toll free number you wait on hold and then the system hangs up on you They really had a negative impact on my vacation and cost me a lot of money

AdenDubai on A Checkin swift and airside in less than mins Flight overbooked caused delay as ground staff sorted out rebookings for disgruntled pax Boarding was mildly confusing as some pax did not respect seat assignments Crew did their best to sort it out and finally got my seat Seat pitch tight for someone over cm limited seat recline good enough for h min flight would have been worse for longhaul Video on safety procedures was running during takeoff Light meal served after takeoff Good selection of juices though only one drink offered Cabin fairly clean but hygiene of restrooms questionable Rule on mobile phone use not enforced by crew and several pax out of their seats emptying overhead bins while taxiing to stand at Dubai quite chaotic

Since most flights to and from YXX are ULCCs my expectations are low Lack of flight info signs Queuing times are nonexistent Clean terminal with easy seating Lack of shops and food inside the secure area WiFi is poor

Getting through the departure area at Banjul airport The Gambia to get to the UK is beyond ridiculous Firstly when you arrive to the airport you have to queue and weigh your luggage outside of the airport on scales You then proceed to pay GMD PP departure tax about at another area You are then shown to the first check in point where you need to show the following Covid test vaccination proof for the UK Evidence that a day test has been booked in the UK We had to challenge the staff here as they were stating that a day was needed as well Not if you are doubled jabbed Covid test result in The Gambia Passenger locator form for the UK PP Luggage drop the conveyor belt does not work So you weigh your luggage and take them off to place them back onto the luggage trolley Air Brussels are strict with weight and do not give you an inch Your hand luggage is also weighed at this point Passengers proceed to bag security where the luggage is scanned checked and can be opened so have your keys ready The bags are then weighed again Once this is done the bags are taken by a man to be placed in holding Next stop The passenger locator form for Brussels then needs to be shown at another desk Travellers then need to proceed to immigration where eye scans a further PP check is done and finger prints are taken Another security check again for hand luggage which is scanned and your PP is checked again The final check is done before you board the plane and access the bus Covid test result despite being shown already Standard PP check boarding pass Hand luggage is weighed again Boarding pass for connecting flights need to be shown as well I would suggest leaving early to get to the airport I would also suggest that you eat inside the airport at the restaurant to the top right The restaurant past the final check point is limited and more expensive too You are also attacked by flies whilst eating There is no duty free shopping either

By far the worst experience ever I have never seen and airport weighting bags and specially handbags by the gram When i said this to the person who did my check in his answer was we follow the rules If you want to follow rules be regular not only where you can exploit foreigners

Both food and souvenir prices are outrageous and they are indicated in USD maybe a better to rip travellers off to dollars for a bowl of pho over for Burger King not even mentioning the drinks Restaurant offer very limited not even a proper coffee shop to seat down A very bitter way to say goodbye to Vietnam
Beirut to Stansted via Larnaca on Cobalt Cobalt is a budget airline so all services are unbundled No meals or refreshments were purchased I will fly Cobalt Airlines whenever I can

Yet another airport that does not provide fresh drinking water free of charge airside Having had a discussion with the security people at passport control they assured me there was no provision for potable water The only option was to buy a plastic bottle of water or use a tap in the toilet but that was not recommended It makes a mockery of the dustbins for recycling different items and that are scattered around the airport see picture It should become mandated that airports provide water free of charge Any claims to be green are otherwise total garbage

About hours before landing a passenger seated D fell off her seat We as passengers got very alarmed while the stewardesses being as robotic as they are took about a good mins before responding to our requests for assistance I am a retired US military with basic CPR knowledge and knew the crew showed how untrained they are to render basic medical assistance another mins past before they finally announced for any doctornurse assistance from the passengers After about an hour the patient was given medical assistance the head steward was more worried about the signing of disclaim papers than worrying about the persons condition On top of that we passengers experienced the most rough and bumpiest landing at MNL I have been riding airplanes since i was a child and a C can land smoother on a dirt runway than what we had to experience landing that night at MNL

I just flew into this airport and not out so I can only say that the bags arrived very quickly and efficiently I will also say that walking from the plane to the terminal and night it seemed as though we were the only people on earth in the middle of nowhere Ive never been to an airport that was so quiet It certainly seemed bereft of planes
